Design bounded correction rules for a frozen HAPPO serial inventory policy.
Nodes: 0 disaster dispensing point, 1 regional warehouse, 2 upstream supply center.
Unchanged simulator: each period external demand plus node0 backlog is served from its inventory and pipeline arrival.
Node1 demand is node0 CURRENT order plus node1 backlog; node2 demand is node1 CURRENT order plus node2 backlog.
Unfilled demand becomes backlog. Next shipments to lower nodes are min(the next node demand including backlog, that next node inventory+arrival BEFORE its update). Node2 receives its own order without supplier constraint. All shipments enter a 4-period pipeline. Orders 0..20.
Primary cost=sum of inventory+backlog at ALL 3 nodes, coefficients all1. Also avoid increasing downstream backlog. An upstream reduction can starve downstream after delay; downstream extra orders can create upstream backlog. Observe all nodes and pipelines together.
You are notified a demand emergency HAS occurred. Future demand, duration and magnitude are unknown. You only see past demand and current state. Do not infer knowledge of the event end. HAPPO does not train.
Return JSON {"candidates":[{"explanation":"...","rules":[{"when":"expression","delta":"expression"}]}]}.
User specifies candidate count (3 initial, 1 refinement). Each rule set contains1..4 ordered first-match rules evaluated separately for each node.
Expression features ONLY: agent, inventory, backlog, pipeline=sum of known in-transit, arrival=next known arrival, incoming=last observed local demand, recent=last5 external mean, baseline=preceding20 external mean, growth=recent/baseline, happo=current proposed order.
Expressions <=300 characters may use numbers, + - * /, comparisons, and/or/not, conditional expressions, min/max2..6args, abs1arg. No other names, code, attributes, imports or containers.
Delta clipped[-6,6], rounded, added to HAPPO order and clipped0..20. Prefer small coordinated corrections and pipeline-aware relaxation. Rules run on fresh causal state for each period. Zero correction is valid.
For feedback, scores are uncertain causal forecast rollouts, not actual future results. Improve both cost and downstream service; do not exploit sample noise. Explain mechanics briefly, no markdown.
Report interval3: each delivered report aggregates3 completed external demands. The demand_mean is repeated3 times only as a reconstruction, never exact within-block demand. Node0 incoming/recent/baseline use delivered reconstruction. Upstream incoming is last executed downstream order. Current inventory, backlog, every pipeline slot, previous orders and current HAPPO proposal are visible. Emergency notification gives no start, magnitude or end. Memory resets each episode and contains only already observed states/orders/delivered reports. Observation changes do not prove a correction caused them. Search feedback is uncertain synthetic prediction; independent review is never supplied to you. Return exactly requested candidate count, one to four valid DSL rules each. This synchronous30-second HTTP timeout is not a real-world execution deadline guarantee.

candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware relaxation: reduce orders when pipeline is high relative to recent demand, to avoid overstock and upstream backlog. For node0, if pipeline exceeds 4 times recent demand, reduce order by 2. For node1, if pipeline exceeds 4 times recent demand, reduce by 2. For node2, if pipeline exceeds 4 times recent demand, reduce by 2. Otherwise no change.

Backlog-driven increase: if backlog is positive, increase order to clear it, but cap increase to avoid overshoot. For node0, if backlog>0, add min(backlog, 2). For node1, if backlog>0, add min(backlog, 2). For node2, if backlog>0, add min(backlog, 2).

Demand-responsive adjustment: if recent demand exceeds baseline (growth>1), increase order to meet higher demand; if recent demand is below baseline (growth<1), decrease order to avoid overstock. For node0, delta = 2*(growth-1) clipped to [-2,2]. For node1, delta = 2*(growth-1) clipped to [-2,2]. For node2, delta = 2*(growth-1) clipped to [-2,2].

Nodes: 0 disaster dispensing point, 1 regional warehouse, 2 upstream supply center.
Unchanged simulator: each period external demand plus node0 backlog is served from its inventory and pipeline arrival.
Node1 demand is node0 CURRENT order plus node1 backlog; node2 demand is node1 CURRENT order plus node2 backlog.
Unfilled demand becomes backlog. Next shipments to lower nodes are min(the next node demand including backlog, that next node inventory+arrival BEFORE its update). Node2 receives its own order without supplier constraint. All shipments enter a 4-period pipeline. Orders 0..20.
Primary cost=sum of inventory+backlog at ALL 3 nodes, coefficients all1. Also avoid increasing downstream backlog. An upstream reduction can starve downstream after delay; downstream extra orders can create upstream backlog. Observe all nodes and pipelines together.
You are notified a demand emergency HAS occurred. Future demand, duration and magnitude are unknown. You only see past demand and current state. Do not infer knowledge of the event end. HAPPO does not train.
Return JSON {"candidates":[{"explanation":"...","rules":[{"when":"expression","delta":"expression"}]}]}.
User specifies candidate count (3 initial, 1 refinement). Each rule set contains1..4 ordered first-match rules evaluated separately for each node.

Design bounded correction rules for a frozen HAPPO serial inventory policy.
Nodes: 0 disaster dispensing point, 1 regional warehouse, 2 upstream supply center.
Unchanged simulator: each period external demand plus node0 backlog is served from its inventory and pipeline arrival.
Node1 demand is node0 CURRENT order plus node1 backlog; node2 demand is node1 CURRENT order plus node2 backlog.
Unfilled demand becomes backlog. Next shipments to lower nodes are min(the next node demand including backlog, that next node inventory+arrival BEFORE its update). Node2 receives its own order without supplier constraint. All shipments enter a 4-period pipeline. Orders 0..20.
Primary cost=sum of inventory+backlog at ALL 3 nodes, coefficients all1. Also avoid increasing downstream backlog. An upstream reduction can starve downstream after delay; downstream extra orders can create upstream backlog. Observe all nodes and pipelines together.
You are notified a demand emergency HAS occurred. Future demand, duration and magnitude are unknown. You only see past demand and current state. Do not infer knowledge of the event end. HAPPO does not train.
Return JSON {"candidates":[{"explanation":"...","rules":[{"when":"expression","delta":"expression"}]}]}.
User specifies candidate count (3 initial, 1 refinement). Each rule set contains1..4 ordered first-match rules evaluated separately for each node.
Expression features ONLY: agent, inventory, backlog, pipeline=sum of known in-transit, arrival=next known arrival, incoming=last observed local demand, recent=last5 external mean, baseline=preceding20 external mean, growth=recent/baseline, happo=current proposed order.
Expressions <=300 characters may use numbers, + - * /, comparisons, and/or/not, conditional expressions, min/max2..6args, abs1arg. No other names, code, attributes, imports or containers.
Delta clipped[-6,6], rounded, added to HAPPO order and clipped0..20. Prefer small coordinated corrections and pipeline-aware relaxation. Rules run on fresh causal state for each period. Zero correction is valid.
For feedback, scores are uncertain causal forecast rollouts, not actual future results. Improve both cost and downstream service; do not exploit sample noise. Explain mechanics briefly, no markdown.
Report interval3: each delivered report aggregates3 completed external demands. The demand_mean is repeated3 times only as a reconstruction, never exact within-block demand. Node0 incoming/recent/baseline use delivered reconstruction. Upstream incoming is last executed downstream order. Current inventory, backlog, every pipeline slot, previous orders and current HAPPO proposal are visible. Emergency notification gives no start, magnitude or end. Memory resets each episode and contains only already observed states/orders/delivered reports. Observation changes do not prove a correction caused them. Search feedback is uncertain synthetic prediction; independent review is never supplied to you. Return exactly requested candidate count, one to four valid DSL rules each. This synchronous30-second HTTP timeout is not a real-world execution deadline guarantee.

agent == 1 and inventory == 0 and backlog > 50 and pipeline < 80
agent == 2 and inventory == 0 and backlog > 0 and pipeline < 80

candidates.explanation: Moderate pipeline-aware relaxation: reduce orders when inventory is high relative to recent demand, but maintain a safety buffer. Upstream nodes order more to replenish pipelines if inventory is low.

Aggressive pipeline-aware relaxation: cut orders sharply when inventory exceeds recent demand, and boost orders when inventory is low to prevent stockouts. Focus on reducing total inventory while avoiding backlog.

Backlog-aware correction: prioritize clearing backlog by increasing orders when backlog exists, and reduce orders when inventory is high and no backlog. This aims to improve service level and reduce holding costs.

Nodes: 0 disaster dispensing point, 1 regional warehouse, 2 upstream supply center.
Unchanged simulator: each period external demand plus node0 backlog is served from its inventory and pipeline arrival.
Node1 demand is node0 CURRENT order plus node1 backlog; node2 demand is node1 CURRENT order plus node2 backlog.
Unfilled demand becomes backlog. Next shipments to lower nodes are min(the next node demand including backlog, that next node inventory+arrival BEFORE its update). Node2 receives its own order without supplier constraint. All shipments enter a 4-period pipeline. Orders 0..20.
Primary cost=sum of inventory+backlog at ALL 3 nodes, coefficients all1. Also avoid increasing downstream backlog. An upstream reduction can starve downstream after delay; downstream extra orders can create upstream backlog. Observe all nodes and pipelines together.
You are notified a demand emergency HAS occurred. Future demand, duration and magnitude are unknown. You only see past demand and current state. Do not infer knowledge of the event end. HAPPO does not train.
Return JSON {"candidates":[{"explanation":"...","rules":[{"when":"expression","delta":"expression"}]}]}.

Report interval3: each delivered report aggregates3 completed external demands. The demand_mean is repeated3 times only as a reconstruction, never exact within-block demand. Node0 incoming/recent/baseline use delivered reconstruction. Upstream incoming is last executed downstream order. Current inventory, backlog, every pipeline slot, previous orders and current HAPPO proposal are visible. Emergency notification gives no start, magnitude or end. Memory resets each episode and contains only already observed states/orders/delivered reports. Observation changes do not prove a correction caused them. Search feedback is uncertain synthetic prediction; independent review is never supplied to you. Return exactly requested candidate count, one to four valid DSL rules each. This synchronous30-second HTTP timeout is not a real-world execution deadline guarantee.

Design bounded correction rules for a frozen HAPPO serial inventory policy.
Nodes: 0 disaster dispensing point, 1 regional warehouse, 2 upstream supply center.
Unchanged simulator: each period external demand plus node0 backlog is served from its inventory and pipeline arrival.
Node1 demand is node0 CURRENT order plus node1 backlog; node2 demand is node1 CURRENT order plus node2 backlog.
Unfilled demand becomes backlog. Next shipments to lower nodes are min(the next node demand including backlog, that next node inventory+arrival BEFORE its update). Node2 receives its own order without supplier constraint. All shipments enter a 4-period pipeline. Orders 0..20.
Primary cost=sum of inventory+backlog at ALL 3 nodes, coefficients all1. Also avoid increasing downstream backlog. An upstream reduction can starve downstream after delay; downstream extra orders can create upstream backlog. Observe all nodes and pipelines together.
You are notified a demand emergency HAS occurred. Future demand, duration and magnitude are unknown. You only see past demand and current state. Do not infer knowledge of the event end. HAPPO does not train.
Return JSON {"candidates":[{"explanation":"...","rules":[{"when":"expression","delta":"expression"}]}]}.
User specifies candidate count (3 initial, 1 refinement). Each rule set contains1..4 ordered first-match rules evaluated separately for each node.
Expression features ONLY: agent, inventory, backlog, pipeline=sum of known in-transit, arrival=next known arrival, incoming=last observed local demand, recent=last5 external mean, baseline=preceding20 external mean, growth=recent/baseline, happo=current proposed order.
Expressions <=300 characters may use numbers, + - * /, comparisons, and/or/not, conditional expressions, min/max2..6args, abs1arg. No other names, code, attributes, imports or containers.
Delta clipped[-6,6], rounded, added to HAPPO order and clipped0..20. Prefer small coordinated corrections and pipeline-aware relaxation. Rules run on fresh causal state for each period. Zero correction is valid.
For feedback, scores are uncertain causal forecast rollouts, not actual future results. Improve both cost and downstream service; do not exploit sample noise. Explain mechanics briefly, no markdown.
Report interval3: each delivered report aggregates3 completed external demands. The demand_mean is repeated3 times only as a reconstruction, never exact within-block demand. Node0 incoming/recent/baseline use delivered reconstruction. Upstream incoming is last executed downstream order. Current inventory, backlog, every pipeline slot, previous orders and current HAPPO proposal are visible. Emergency notification gives no start, magnitude or end. Memory resets each episode and contains only already observed states/orders/delivered reports. Observation changes do not prove a correction caused them. Search feedback is uncertain synthetic prediction; independent review is never supplied to you. Return exactly requested candidate count, one to four valid DSL rules each. This synchronous30-second HTTP timeout is not a real-world execution deadline guarantee.
